offering_description.value: Proto Labs makes custom prototypes and production parts for product developers, engineering teams and manufacturers. Customers upload digital designs for quoting and order parts made in company facilities or through a network of manufacturing partners.

primary_products.value: Custom plastic and metal prototypes; low-volume production parts; replacement parts

primary_services.value: CNC machining; injection molding; industrial 3D printing; sheet metal fabrication

customer_segment.value: B2B: Product development teams, equipment manufacturers, engineering firms and hardware startups

end_markets.value: Industrial equipment; medical devices; automotive; aerospace and defense; electronics

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Quoted orders to manufacture custom prototypes and production runs, including tooling where needed

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns customer CAD designs and plastic or metal feedstock into custom parts for engineering teams and manufacturers; software / platform: Routes customer designs and orders to vetted manufacturing partners that make parts for business customers

geography_served.value: global: Serves customers primarily in North America and Europe through company facilities and an international supplier network

specialization.value: related lines: CNC machining, injection molding, industrial 3D printing and sheet metal fabrication for prototypes and production parts

distribution_channels.value: online: Web portals for CAD uploads, quotes and orders; direct sales: Sales and account teams for engineering and procurement customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Manufacturing operations subject to workplace safety and environmental rules enforced by OSHA, EPA and local counterparts

notes: Sheet metal fabrication availability may vary by region.
